title: Koya Proposal Studio
summary: An AI-assisted proposal workflow that moves from discovery input to generation, manual editing, immutable version review, independent approval, PDF generation, and controlled delivery.
problem: Generating a proposal is only one step of a real sales workflow. The harder requirement is ensuring the exact content submitted for review stays stable, approval is independent, delivery is controlled, and failures are visible rather than silently corrupting the workflow.
system: Sales users capture discovery context and supporting materials, generate and revise proposal sections, submit an immutable version for an independent approver, generate the approved content as a client-facing PDF, and deliver it through a controlled email boundary with delivery history.

engineeringDecisions.title: Immutable proposal versions
engineeringDecisions.detail: Generation, section regeneration, and manual edits create new snapshots so approval never points at a silently changing document.

engineeringDecisions.title: Database-enforced transitions
engineeringDecisions.detail: Submission, approval, and delivery rules are protected through RLS and security-definer RPCs rather than only UI state.

engineeringDecisions.title: Separate creator and approver
engineeringDecisions.detail: Self-approval is blocked at the data layer to preserve an actual review boundary.

reliability.title: Exact-version review
reliability.detail: Approvers see the submitted snapshot rather than the live editable proposal.

reliability.title: Recoverable delivery history
reliability.detail: Delivery attempts are logged, including uncertain outcomes where provider confirmation cannot be trusted.

reliability.title: Workflow test pack
reliability.detail: Prepared scenarios cover intake, generation, supporting materials, approval, delivery, and important edge cases alongside automated tests.

result: A proposal system where AI generation sits inside an auditable workflow with version integrity, independent approval, explicit delivery state, and end-to-end verification.

evidence.label: Source repository
evidence.description: Application, migrations, tests, and manual workflow test pack.

evidence.label: End-to-end workflow tests
evidence.description: Vitest integration coverage and Playwright tests exercise the proposal flow against the hosted Supabase project.

title: Real-Time Voice AI Agent
summary: A real-time conversational AI system combining LiveKit’s voice pipeline with Agno agents for tool calling, knowledge, memory, and context-aware interactions.
problem: Voice agents have to combine low-latency media handling with richer agent behavior without turning the real-time audio path into a tightly coupled application-specific implementation.
system: An Agno integration plugs agentic tool calling, knowledge, memory, and session context into LiveKit’s real-time VAD, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and streaming pipeline, with a LiveKit Meet interface used as the interaction surface.

engineeringDecisions.title: Plugin-style agent integration
engineeringDecisions.detail: Agno capabilities are introduced as an integration layer instead of replacing LiveKit’s real-time media primitives.

engineeringDecisions.title: Persistent agent context
engineeringDecisions.detail: Session and user identifiers support context and memory across interactions.

engineeringDecisions.title: Separate interface from agent core
engineeringDecisions.detail: The Meet surface is treated as the UI/runtime surface for the same system rather than a second independent portfolio project.

reliability.title: Streaming-first interaction
reliability.detail: Responses are streamed into the live session rather than waiting for a complete batch result.

reliability.title: Explicit service credentials
reliability.detail: LiveKit, model, and speech-provider configuration remains server-side through environment variables.

result: A real-time AI integration that demonstrates how conversational agent features can sit inside a production-oriented voice transport rather than only a text-chat loop.

evidence.label: Agno integration
evidence.description: Primary repository for the LiveKit Agents / Agno plugin and agent setup.

evidence.label: Interaction surface
evidence.description: LiveKit Meet repository used as the real-time UI surface.
